B) as applicable provided they fulfill all eligibility criteria for that category.
Note 6: Only those candidates of Outstanding Sports Person (OSP) Categories have been considered who have produced Gradation Certificate issued by Competent Authority in Haryana at the time of interview. The Merit list of OSP Candidates
has been prepared as per the gradation priority fixed by Government in the priority order i.e. A-1, A-2, B-1, B-2, C-1, C-2, D-1, D-2. Gradation Certificate issued after the date of Interview has not been considered.
COMPLETE LIST OF APPLICANTS CALLED FOR INTERVIEW FOR THE POST OF FOREST GUARD VIDE ADVERTISEMENT NO. 01 DATED 06-03-2013
BY DEPARTMENTAL SELECTION COMMITTEE, FOREST DEPARTMENT, HARYANA.
Note 1: The appointment of the Ex Service Men (ESM) are provisional subject to submission of latest Eligibility Certificates issued by competent authorities/ Zila Sainik Board at the time of joining in the Forest Department.
Note 2: The selection of candidates are provisional subject to verification of records at the time of joining. The selected candidates have not been medically examined and no special inquiry into their antecedents has been made. The documents
pertaining to their qualifications, age and caste/category as claimed by them, in their applications forms, will be checked/verified from the issuing authorities, if need be, before they are allowed to join their duties.
Note 8: Although every care has been taken in preparing the following information, possibility of inadvertent errors cannot be ruled out. The Selection Committee reserves the right to rectify the same later on.
Note 3: Physically Efficiency Test (P.E.T.) was qulalifying in nature and no marks have been awarded and added in the Merit List.
Note 4: Percentage of Marks in academic is based on the marksheet produced in the interview board at the time of verification of record and interview.
Note 7: In case more than one candidate in a category have got equal aggregiate marks (academic + interview) then the older candidate has been ranked senior to younger candidate.
